paper_id: Zhang et al. - 2016 - Privacy-friendly photo capturing and sharing system
title: Privacy-friendly Photo Capturing and Sharing System
motivation: Smart cameras enable secretive photographing that violates portrait privacy without notification or consent
problem_framing: Erase invisible users from photos while preserving privacy during matching against untrusted cloud
key_insight: Vector distance is dimension-order-independent, enabling encryption-free privacy-preserving matching via scrambling + LSH
method_signature: Graph-based portrait profile + voting graph matching + privacy-preserving vector transformation
evaluation_criteria: False negative/positive rates, communication cost, computation runtime, recall/precision
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Accuracy depends on people detection and segmentation; complicated environment may cause high error rate
evidence_for_taste: visible tags on cloth are inaesthetic
face recognition suffers when there is a lack of a clear front view
the computation overhead is large for homomorphic encryption
the accuracy is highly dependent on the performance of people detection
thinking_moves: 把隐私保护重新frame成图片 erasing问题而非遮挡问题
将人脸识别精度问题转嫁为图匹配鲁棒性设计
利用向量距离的维度顺序无关性绕过加密计算
用图结构替代原图来降低传输隐私风险
cites_own_work: Zhang et al. - 2015 - Message in a sealed bottle
